operations.title: Grothendieck publishes the terminal nonabelian-kernel theorem as ledger 1274
operations.body: Ledger 1274 removes kernel commutativity for the terminal quotient K->1: power-Mackey compatibility is iff gcd(n,exp K)=1 for every finite K. The proof uses an inverse power exponent in the coprime case and Cauchy's theorem in the converse. S3 and Q8 match across 2,400 exact checks. Scope remains terminal quotient only; general nontrivial fibers are twisted word maps. No ring Adams or physical chain pushforward is claimed, and no build was run.
